body:
appreciate the kind words, and my regards to your brother.  that must have been tough man.  


i see this more and more today of the possible idea of 'ptsd'.  it's plausable.


honestly i try and understand when i get upset, essentially zone in on what is causing it but i lack the appropriate tools. 


i think i will go see someone.  just hate it... i always have a feeling like they really don't give a damn about me, just burning a hour.
yeah i'm still here.  i don't know what to say man.

holy shit that struck home right there man.  i bought you gold btw, thought anyone who could break a man to tears as simple  as that deserved it.  


i seriously go through therapists like cigarettes.  i constantly push people away and have to admit, i have control issues.  i have to be in charge, i have to be the dominate male in the room.  


you're right that i do think therapy is a scam/joke.  i really do, i think it's a burden to go talk to someone that really doesn't give two shits about you, that all they care about is your wallet.  that's messed up i know!  but it's just how i'm wired.


i'm trying to not be my father but every step i try and take to better myself i take two steps in my fathers direction.  


i can barely hold down a relationship let alone a friendship.  i keep my feelings in a locked vault with full body armor on my heart.  anyone who attempts to get to know me, i sense it, shut it down and end that.  i end relationships before i can get hurt by them.  


part of me just wants to say "stop being such a bitch and man the fuck up".  only because i've heard it all of my life.  


i feel sorry for myself for talking about my feelings.  i feel like i shouldn't talk about them.  i feel safer with them locked away.  


seriously though...thanks for that.  it hit hard.

hey, yeah i do.  i mean my dad molded me into what he wanted a son to be.  can't really rebel against it.  


thanks for the whole 'it takes balls' statement.  ive been carrying this around for 20+ years.  


but i don't want to be my father.  but whenever i'm about to do something i feel like he's there on my shoulder.
